pairs.subject: quality-gates
pairs.evidence: apps/stage/src/voice/report.ts:30 The client promises that a watched `rig` means the face was on screen, yet it sends the state only on change with no heartbeat, so the gate reading voice.jsonl cannot tell a face still drawn from one that went dark after the last report.

techniques.evidence: apps/stage/src/voice/session.ts:153 The wire has no liveness signal for the held state, and the `face` check has no other input, although the recording exists and the sibling av_sync and dead_air checks read it. A missing first report is handled loudly (watch.rs:244 returns unmeasured); only the stale held state escapes.
apps/stage/src/voice/report.ts:33 Nothing drawn and the placeholder both report silhouette, so an unknown form cannot count toward the rig share.

apps/stage/scripts/lint-gate.test.mjs:82 The voice decoder's JSON.parse exemption is proven by running ESLint on a seeded copy under the real file name, so the engine's resolved configuration is tested rather than the config text.
apps/stage/src/voice/frame.ts:39 One decoder door held by a negative-space lint rule; there is no per-operation wrapper table that a tag bijection would close.

pairs.subject: quality-gates
pairs.evidence: characters/malakor/constitution.md:4 The reviewed-commit rule has no mechanism behind it: no check refuses a direct commit to this file, and the daemon's documented character.doc.set path replaces it after an approval card with no commit at all, so the stated rule describes neither route.

techniques.evidence: characters/malakor/constitution.md:4 Audit answer for a direct commit: only a person noticing in review (git ls-files finds no CODEOWNERS). crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/character_doc.rs:31 lists the file as replaceable, and docs/spec/contract.md:2291 documents that carve-out while this line was not updated. Partly backed: the Reconciler's path is refused at the action (crates/shadowrunr-reconcile/src/verify.rs:179), and agent writes are approval-gated.

crates/shadowrunr-brain/src/character.rs:1445 The real package is validated inside the Rust test suite, the merge rung, as well as by the `character validate` command and at write time through write_validated.
crates/shadowrunr-brain/src/character.rs:1587 The validator is fed a defective copy of this package's own situations.json and must report it, so a known-bad input is seen to fail.
crates/shadowrunr-brain/src/rules.rs:174 The refusal names both package-relative files involved, and the remedy sits inside the package the reader is editing.
